parameters.name: BillingCycle
parameters.description: The billing cycle in YYYY-MM format. Only billing cycles in the last 18 months are supported.

parameters.name: BillingDate
parameters.description: The billing date. This parameter is required only when **Granularity** is set to DAILY. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: Granularity
parameters.description:
The granularity of the bills to query. Valid values:

- MONTHLY: monthly. The data is consistent with the bills aggregated by billing cycle in the User Center.

- DAILY: daily. The data is consistent with the bills aggregated by day in the User Center.

If you set this parameter to DAILY, you must also specify **BillingDate**.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service instance.
